verdictBasis: PROJECT-ID-V1, SNAPSHOT-ID-V1 and PLAN-ID-V1 now form one reproducible upstream identity chain; the full Rust plus TypeScript provider vector reproduces independently; recursive validation, exact admission equality, ProjectId lifecycle, every declared identity-to-D9 projection, stored-read RequestId validation, parsed-JSON totality and the layer-4 product-checker repair all survive independent probes. IP-R4-01, R7-SN-01 and R7-C2-04 therefore PASS at IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED. IP-R4-02 remains CONDITIONAL. The known EvidenceBundle closed-schema patch is still unintegrated, and a second residual exists: OPERABILITY labels generic fact identity mechanically proven even though no live contract defines FactEnvelope.factId derivation and the asserted fact projection pair is not computed or type-checked. The six other recipe-less identity/key surfaces are honestly parked and are not silently promoted. Architecture checker success is not product qualification or release demonstration.

Independent Node.js recomputation matched every Project/Snapshot/Plan oracle, including the full Rust plus TypeScript vector.

newFindings.category: RequestId semantic exclusion / generic FactId derivation
newFindings.title: Generic FactId exclusion is called mechanically proven without a FactId recipe or an honest parked status
newFindings.statement: OPERABILITY mechanically joins 'FactEnvelope and body identity input' and asserts an equal factEnvelopeSemanticProjection for two RequestIds. FACT-PLANE defines factId only as a ContentDigest. FACT-IDENTITY's opensip.fact-identity.v1 byte grammar starts from a source body span and defines the normalization/finding-anchor identity ladder; it never names FactEnvelope.factId or a full-envelope preimage. DELIVERY nevertheless says the host canonicalises the full fact envelope and mints/verifies factId under FACT-IDENTITY. Changing both asserted fact projection values to equal non-digest text leaves check-operability.py clean, proving that the pair is equality prose rather than a computed identity oracle.
newFindings.impact: A host can include contextual RequestId in an otherwise unspecified factId derivation while all current RequestId checks remain green. This is exactly the semantic leak the exclusion claim says is mechanically impossible, and an implementer must invent where generic fact identity comes from.
newFindings.requiredChange: Either bind a closed, domain-separated generic FactEnvelope.factId preimage and independently computed RequestId-variation vector, with DELIVERY and FACT-PLANE joined to it, or add generic FactId derivation to parkedNoExactRecipe, remove it from mechanicallyJoined/expectedInvariantPairs, and stop claiming mechanical proof until that recipe exists.
